## In-Depth Project Case Studies
### Project 1: AQ Sentinel — IoT Air Quality Telemetry & Visualization
- Overview: An IoT environmental monitoring system developed to provide accessible real-time telemetry on ambient air quality without expensive commercial sensors.
- Problem Statement: Commercial air quality monitoring hardware in Nepal is cost-prohibitive for schools and community centers, leaving local communities without granular pollution data.
- Architecture:
  - Hardware: Espressif ESP32 microcontroller interfaced with particulate matter (PM2.5/PM10) and gas sensors.
  - Telemetry Pipeline: Lightweight JSON payloads transmitted over HTTP/MQTT to a Node.js telemetry aggregator.
  - User Interface: React web application rendering live graphical trends, health threshold alerts, and air quality index (AQI) calculations.
- Honors: Won 1st Place at the St. Xavier's College intra-college STEAM Exhibition (2025).
- Reference: https://projects.bamanguragain.com.np/aq-sentinel

### Project 2: MeroAushadhi — AI-Driven Native Healthcare Information
- Overview: A bilingual medicine information application addressing health literacy barriers for Nepali-speaking citizens.
- Problem Statement: Pharmacological instructions, drug interactions, and dosage cautions in Nepal are predominantly published in English or complex medical jargon, resulting in misuse and low adherence.
- Architecture:
  - AI Pipeline: Google Generative AI integration orchestrating conversational health queries with contextual prompt templates.
  - Workflow Automation: Flowise low-code LLM orchestration engine managing question-answering pipelines.
  - Data Persistence: Supabase (PostgreSQL with Row Level Security) storing medicine catalog metadata and user bookmarks.
  - Frontend: Responsive React interface with clean typography, accessibility-first contrast, and native Nepali phonetic support.
- Honors: Awarded 3rd Place Overall and Best UI/UX Award at Cambridge Code League Hackathon (Feb 2025).
- Reference: https://projects.bamanguragain.com.np/meroaushadhi

### Project 3: A-Level Past Paper Extractor — Desktop Automation Suite
- Overview: A Python desktop automation tool simplifying examination preparation for Cambridge International A-Level students.
- Problem Statement: Navigating third-party past paper repositories requires manually opening dozens of browser tabs, clicking ad-laden links, and sorting question papers and marking schemes into folders.
- Architecture:
  - Graphical Interface: Python CustomTkinter library providing modern dark-mode controls and responsive feedback.
  - Scraping & Download Engine: Python Requests library handling structured scraping of BestExamHelp endpoints across 2021-2024 examination series.
  - File System Management: Automatic classification into subject, year, exam session (May/June, Oct/Nov), and paper type (QP, MS, ER).
- Reference: https://projects.bamanguragain.com.np/question-paper-extractor
